flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/section-3.description: Introductory text: the Worcester F51/F52 series flanged ball valve is standardized in design, materials and construction for worldwide availability and shorter lead times, with interchangeable parts available in all regions and support from Quick Response Centers (QRCs).
flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/section-3.use_for: Answers general questions about the valve's standardization, availability and service support.

flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/section-4.description: Short text on reliability and safety: bubble-tight shutoff, a live-loaded packing design against fugitive emissions and a threaded end plug design that ensures positive retention and eliminates blowout risk.
flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/section-4.use_for: Answers questions about the valve's shutoff, packing and blowout-safety design.

flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/section-6.description: Numbered feature list belonging to the cutaway drawing: actuator mounting to ISO 5211 and Shell MESC SPE 77/300, anti-blowout duplex stainless steel stem, gland nut locking clip, live-loaded packing (API 641, ISO 15848), cavity pressure-relieving seat, PTFE body seals with fire-safe metal-to-metal secondary sealing, anti-static design, threaded insert, locking wrench through NPS 4 (DN100) and an optional O-ring stem seal.
flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/section-6.use_for: Use it to find the standard design features of the valve and the standards they conform to.
flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/section-6.uncertain: The text also holds the callout numbers of flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/fig-3.1 as stray lines.

flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/section-10.description: Notes under the pressure/temperature chart: material group ratings are taken from ASME B16.34; Group 1.2 is the dual-certified LCB/LCC and WCB/WCC material, Group 2.2 the CF8M material; maximum seat temperatures are on page 7.
flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/section-10.use_for: Use it to find which body materials the chart's Group 1.2 and Group 2.2 curves stand for and where the ratings come from.

flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/section-11.description: Heading of the seat materials page with a pointer to the pressure/temperature curves on page 6.

flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/section-12.description: Seat material Delrin (D), POM or acetal homopolymer: durable, tough, low friction, good creep resistance for high-pressure applications; maximum temperature rating 80 °C (180 °F).
flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/section-12.use_for: Use it to find the properties and maximum temperature of the Delrin seat.

flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/section-13.description: Seat material UHMWPE (U), ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene: for applications where PTFE is not suitable (tobacco duty), good abrasion resistance; maximum temperature rating 90 °C (200 °F).
flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/section-13.use_for: Use it to find the properties and maximum temperature of the UHMWPE seat.

flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/section-14.description: Seat material Virgin PTFE (T): the most common sealing material, excellent chemical resistance and low friction for low operating torque; maximum temperature rating 230 °C (450 °F).
flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/section-14.use_for: Use it to find the properties and maximum temperature of the virgin PTFE seat.

flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/section-15.description: Seat material Reinforced PTFE (R), glass-reinforced: stronger and more wear-resistant than virgin PTFE, for higher pressure/temperature or high cycling; maximum temperature rating 230 °C (450 °F).
flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/section-15.use_for: Use it to find the properties and maximum temperature of the reinforced PTFE seat.

flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/section-16.description: Seat material Fluorofill/Polyfill (P), PTFE reinforced with carbon, glass and graphite: dimensionally stable, suited to steam and cryogenic services and recommended for modulating control; maximum temperature rating 260 °C (500 °F).
